description: Share a few images of what you'd wear — outfit photos, Pinterest pins, screenshots, a mood board — and Muse reads the taste behind them: a name for the aesthetic, its palette, and clothes from independent brands that fit it, with links to buy. Or describe the look in words. Muse is free and needs no account. It reads several images as one taste rather than matching a single item, so the result is a wardrobe you can build on, not a look-alike search. Muse may earn a commission on some purchases; that never changes what is shown. Made by Muse Studio LLC.
